Pipeline editors cannot write `.claude/**` (the review sandbox excludes those paths), so the autofix loop cannot close this gap; a trusted interactive operator must copy `workflow-templates/.claude/settings.json` and `workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py` over the live paths byte for byte on `orchestrator/project-7126`, or the post-merge live-copy sync PR for the `main` change must land and `main` must be merged into this branch again. Without that, every subsequent autofix iteration on the same head will keep re-running with the same red `lint`, `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator`, and `tests-release-and-log-analysis` checks regardless of how many reap-loop or jq-filter refinements the editor applies.
